ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-02-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioners Paul Gregory and Mary Anne Woten were present in pro per as guardians ad litem for the minors Britanny Merced Salazar Woten and Elliot Tomarza Salazar Woten.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to: Britanny Merced Woten Salazar and Elliot Tomarza Woten Salazar.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
